normal_orientation_method: All source meshes run bmesh.ops.recalc_face_normals before export; reimported loop normals must be finite/unit; per-object signed volume is authoritative for this union of solids; 31,500 deterministic visibility rays test the first visible face from nine interior targets, with a 0.15% residual allowed at coincident faces.
centering_note: Origin is the measured footprint ring bbox centre, so the building stands on its true coordinates (AGENTS rule 5). The full bbox is ~2.4 m wider than the 40.0 x 41.8 m footprint on each axis because the cornice projects 1.05 m past the wall all the way round; that overhang is symmetric, so the bbox centre still lands on the footprint centre.
